# docs/images/source-cofdm-instrumented.png — COFDM with the `X` panel up.
#
# Regenerated by scripts/regen-docs-images.sh.  The still's label is this file's
# basename, and that is what names the PNG.

set run.size 1200x828
set run.scale 2
set run.duration 22

0.00  source COFDM
0.50  key D                  # decode bar -> Di
1.00  key X                  # extended instrumentation panel

21.00 still source-cofdm-instrumented
                             # the second burst, ~9 s in: every panel field has
                             # a measured reading, and none is still `—`
